key_insight: BayesPath improves whole-slide pathology reasoning by updating diagnostic beliefs while accounting for unreliable and correlated AI observations.
clinical_relevance: An interpretable evidence trail and better-calibrated uncertainty could support pathology review and deferral of uncertain cases, but clinical utility remains unproven.
method: Uses a training-free Scan–Look–Weigh–Decide workflow with explicit Bayesian beliefs over candidate answers.
Adjusts evidence for model answer bias, correlated observations, and diagnostic confusions estimated without labels.
Uses updated beliefs to guide region selection and determine when to stop.
evidence_signal: Across five MultiPathQA slide classification and visual question-answering tasks, BayesPath achieved 58.6% average accuracy versus 34.1% for the next-best training-free agent.
watch_item: Benchmark gains do not establish clinical safety; reliability estimates and stopping decisions need validation in real-world pathology workflows.
paper_title: BayesPath: Reliability-Aware Bayesian Reasoning for Whole-Slide Pathology Agents
